knowledge_base_entries.rationale: Factorio requires designing interlocking production systems and automating decisions with in-game circuit logic, directly paralleling systems design and boolean logic coursework.
Building redstone circuits means wiring functional logic gates and switching networks in-game, a hands-on introduction to boolean logic and digital circuit design.

knowledge_base_entries.course_title: Applied Systems Engineering & Life Support Design
knowledge_base_entries.rationale: Stationeers requires managing interdependent power, atmosphere, and industrial systems to keep a space colony alive, directly paralleling engineering systems design and applied physical science.
Minecraft play involves planning structures, managing finite resources, and iterating on designs, which maps to introductory engineering and spatial design skills.
Card games built around betting require constant probability estimation and expected-value tradeoffs, core concepts in an introductory statistics course.
Chess play develops multi-step strategic planning and pattern recognition, foundational to game theory and formal logic.
Structured self-directed activity on a guided platform demonstrates independent goal-setting and follow-through, credited as independent study time.
Building playable games requires writing and debugging logic and designing for a player experience, core introductory programming skills.
Simulation games centered on earning, spending, and managing limited time build practical budgeting and economics intuition.
Constructive building play develops structural intuition and fine motor precision central to introductory engineering.
Cooking and baking require precise measurement, fraction conversion, and understanding of chemical reactions like leavening.
Hands-on gardening involves observing plant life cycles and testing growing conditions, core botany and environmental science skills.
Deep interest in dinosaurs and fossils builds research and classification skills central to earth science and paleontology.

Language Arts (reading).connection: Regular reading builds vocabulary, comprehension, and exposure to varied sentence structure and narrative technique.
Language Arts (reading).evaluation: Sustained independent reading time is standard, credit-bearing coursework in a Language Arts curriculum.

Physical Education (sports).opening: Structured physical activity involving a specific sport or athletic practice.
Physical Education (sports).connection: Repeated practice builds physical conditioning, coordination, and goal-directed skill development.
Physical Education (sports).evaluation: Regular structured physical activity is standard, credit-bearing coursework in a Physical Education curriculum.

generic (wildcard).opening: A self-directed learning activity outside a formal curriculum.
generic (wildcard).connection: This activity develops practical skills and understanding through direct, hands-on engagement rather than textbook instruction.
generic (wildcard).evaluation: Documented, real-world engagement of this kind is recognized as credit-bearing coursework when tied to a specific subject area.
